children: ) (“Light & Wonder” or the “Company”), announced today that it will release its financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, on Wednesday, November 4, 2026, after the U.S. markets close, and before the ASX opens on Thursday, November 5, 2026. The Company will host an investor conference call and simultaneous webcast those same days at 5:00 p.m. U.S. Eastern Time / 9:00 a.m. Australian Eastern Daylight Time to discuss the results.

To access the live webcast of the call, please visit the Company’s website at https://explore.investors.lnw.com and click on the webcast link. A replay of the webcast will be available approximately one hour after the webcast and will be archived on the Company’s website.
Participants will be given a unique PIN to gain access to the call by registering at Light & Wonder earnings call. Participants may pre-register at any time, including up to the call start time.
Conference call dial-in PIN: Unique PIN provided upon registration

The Company is committed to the highest standards of integrity, from promoting player responsibility to implementing sustainable practices. To learn more visit www.lnw.com.
